text:
ashley: Quick sync — we need to lock a time for the design review of the multi-model routing API + Console UX changes. This is the design pass before RFC, so want API surface + SDK ergonomics + console flows reviewed. Expected length: 45m.

mike: +1 — can we do next Tue/Wed? I need to align with infra folks for staging tests.

sania: I can do Tue afternoon PST or Wed morning CET. sharing my calendar: https://cal.example.com/sania

leo: Wed works better for me; prefer 9:30–10:15am PT.

devin: I'm on call Tue, but Wed 10 PT is OK. Also can prep the perf numbers for batching.

ashley: Cool. Options for poll (all times PT):
• Wed 10:00–10:45
• Wed 11:00–11:45
• Thu 09:00–09:45
Please reply with your preference and flag any blockers.

jordan: Wed 10 is my +1. Also: who will own the pre-read?

ashley: I'll own collecting pre-reads. Draft checklist below — please add missing items. I'll publish a single doc for reviewers.

design-bot: reminder: add "Console mockups" and "access to staging" to checklist.

ashley: Pre-read checklist (copy/paste into the doc):
```
- Design doc (go/routing-design) — author: ashley
- API contract proto + examples (open link) — author: mike
- SDK sample usage + migration notes — author: sania
- Console mockups + flows (Figma) — author: leo
- Perf baseline & cost delta (bench notes) — author: devin
- E2E test plan + staging access steps — owner: infra team
- Rollout & canary plan outline — owner: product/ashley
```

mike: I'll add a minimal OpenAPI snippet and a short migration guide. cc @sania for SDK sample format.

sania: Got it, I'll produce examples for JS + Python and call out breaking changes. ETA Mon EOD.

leo: I'll drop Figma links and a 3-slide flow doc by Mon. Want a quick read-only walkthrough during the review.

devin: Perf numbers will be coarse — I need to run the new batching config against the canary images. Putting a note in the checklist.

ashley: Can someone from infra confirm staging namespaces + test tokens will be available Wed morning? @mike can you ping infra?

mike: pinging infra now. infra ping: @infra-team — can we get a staging namespace with routing-enabled and a test key for the reviewers by Tue EOD?

design-bot: Thanks. infra-team assigned ticket #INF-3421. ETA Tue 17:00 PT.

jordan: Thanks for owning the doc, ashley. One ask: include a short list of acceptance criteria for the design — e.g., API backward-compat, SDK migration path, console clarity for routing priority.

ashley: Good call. I'll add an acceptance criteria section. Draft criteria: 
- No breaking changes for default API calls;
- SDK migration path documented with examples;
- Console shows routing priority and health indicators;
- Canary rollout <=10% traffic for 48h with auto-fallback.

mike: LGTM. Also can we keep the review interactive: 20m walkthrough, 20m focused feedback, 5m decisions & owners?

ashley: Plan to structure it like that. If we have a big red flag on compatibility we'll punt to RFC stage.

reminder-bot: note: please upload pre-reads to the shared folder by Mon 18:00 PT or the review will be informational only.

leo: uploading mockups now — link: https://figma.example.com/file/xyz

ashley: Final ask: add any code snippets or short repros to the doc. If you need me to synth a small demo repo, say so.

devin: I can put a small perf repro in a gist.

mike: I'll add OpenAPI snippet + example curl.

ashley: OK — collating items. Tentative: Wed 10:00–10:45 PT. I'll create the calendar invite once pre-reads are in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
